changelog: v0.4.9: 1) Added 'Real Room (Immersed)' as a selectable 5th space in the environment gallery and thumbstick rotation, enabling full Mixed Reality Passthrough where the avatar stands in your physical room; 2) Fixed Right Controller pointer selection by binding WebXR select listeners directly to each controller and correctly mapping gamepad input indices, ensuring both left and right controller beams point and select In-VR console buttons reliably.
